_disclaimer: Default values are calibrated against a defined reference baseline of bugfest environment (currently 3 standalone tenants, and 11 consortia tenants). See ADR-0013 (Module configuration management) for the governance model behind this file.

deployment.description: Deployment configuration for the edge module. edge-rtac is a stateless, synchronous proxy (request-in -> Okapi call-out -> response-out) with no persistence, no Kafka, and no scheduled jobs, so replicas require no coordination and can be scaled horizontally without restriction.

kong.description: Standard Kong proxy timeouts. edge-rtac does no cache-miss fan-out or background work like mod-rtac-cache; its own request_timeout_ms (default 30s) already bounds downstream Okapi call latency, so the platform default timeouts provide adequate headroom without a custom override.

EnvVars.name: PORT
EnvVars.description: Server port the edge module listens on.

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_URL
EnvVars.description: Okapi base URL used to route all outbound calls into the FOLIO cluster.

EnvVars.name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
EnvVars.description: Timeout in milliseconds for outbound calls to Okapi-routed downstream modules.

EnvVars.name: TOKEN_CACHE_CAPACITY
EnvVars.description: Maximum number of entries in the JWT token cache.

EnvVars.name: TOKEN_CACHE_TTL_MS
EnvVars.description: How long a cached JWT is retained, in milliseconds.

EnvVars.name: NULL_TOKEN_CACHE_TTL_MS
EnvVars.description: How long a failed/null token lookup is cached before retrying, in milliseconds.

EnvVars.name: SECURE_STORE
EnvVars.description: Secure store backend used to resolve secrets. Valid values: Ephemeral, AwsSsm, Vault.

EnvVars.name: SECURE_STORE_PROPS
EnvVars.description: Path to the properties file configuring the selected secure store backend.
